# Working with NetSuite for Mobile

Working with NetSuite for Mobile (74 pages): Working with NetSuite for Mobile

## Chapters
- [Working with NetSuite for Mobile](chapter_1554101840.md): The following sections cover tasks that NetSuite for Mobile enables you to perform.
  - [NetSuite for Mobile Login Options](section_1554101855.md): Logging in to the app does not affect any NetSuite session you may have open in a browser.
  - [Changing Roles in NetSuite for Mobile](section_1554106630.md): You can select roles with the Mobile Device Access permission enabled as follows.
  - [NetSuite for Mobile Expense Reporting](section_1554107695.md): If you have the necessary permissions, My Dashboard includes the My Expenses portlet by default.
  - [Expense Reporting Access Levels](article_164154627723.md): Your expense reporting capabilities depend on your access level.
  - [NetSuite for Mobile Time Tracking](section_1554297914.md): NetSuite for Mobile enables you to perform time tracking tasks from your mobile device.
  - [NetSuite for Mobile Dashboards](section_1553858494.md): NetSuite for Mobile enables you to configure and use all web dashboards.
  - [NetSuite for Mobile Calendar](section_156258892134.md): The Calendar feature lets you create and accept new activities, and customize your calendar view based on an entity, group, or resource.
  - [NetSuite for Mobile Record Management](section_1554466775.md): The types of records you can view and edit depends on the role with which you log in.
  - [NetSuite for Mobile Sublist Management](section_1554718735.md): When you view a record, a predefined selection of sublists displays below the summary view.
  - [Tracking Calls with Phone Call Logging in NetSuite for iOS](section_4120642128.md): Note: Please note this feature is unavailable on Android due to API restrictions enforced by Google.
  - [Viewing Customer Activity Logs in NetSuite for Mobile](section_0407104423.md): NetSuite for Mobile enables you to view recent activities related to a customer such as calls, events, invoices, and other interactions.
  - [Creating and Attaching Notes to Customer Records in NetSuite for iOS](section_0801012604.md): NetSuite for iOS enables you to attach notes to customer records.
  - [My Approvals in NetSuite for Mobile](section_1554194643.md): The My Approvals portlet provides a reminder of any outstanding expenses, purchase orders, time entries, and time sheets awaiting your authorization.
  - [Accessing Saved Searches in the App](section_1554465419.md): If you add the Custom Searches portlet to your Home dashboard in a browser session, it also appears on your app's Home dashboard.
